user.title: TOPDON BatteryLab
user.description: Select the device to add. It must be powered and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

abort.not_supported: This device is not supported by the integration.
abort.no_devices_found: No supported TOPDON device found. It must be powered. If the TOPDON BatteryLab phone app has been used since the device was last powered up, it stops advertising to anything else - disconnect it from the battery for about 30 seconds, then reconnect.

exchange.name: Exchange raw frames
exchange.description: Write one or more raw TOPDON commands and return every notification heard afterwards. Protocol-exploration tool: the reply does not have to decode, so it works on opcodes whose payload layout is not known yet.

commands.name: Commands
commands.description: Hex commands, first two bytes are the opcode, the rest are arguments. Framing and checksum are added automatically.

listen.name: Listen seconds
listen.description: How long to keep collecting notifications after the last write.
